title: The Space a Shade Leaves
deck: The shade and the seating reveal how contrast guides the eye across a composition.

features.headline: What the shade leaves open
features.narrative: The drawn shade frames a small stand; the contrast leaves space around the light.
features.discoveryQuestion: How might another shade guide light across a surface?

features.headline: Room around a rounded silhouette
features.narrative: The rounded seating holds the foreground; the space around its silhouette creates contrast.
features.discoveryQuestion: How might a path guide the eye between shapes?

connections.thread: Compare how the shade frames light with how seating leaves space around a silhouette.
